# WEBRO Studio

> WEBRO Studio is a web and AI development agency in Jaipur, India, working with businesses worldwide. We build websites, mobile apps, online stores, custom software and AI automation at fixed prices, and the client owns all code and accounts.

- Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Clients in India, the US, UK, UAE, Canada and Australia.

- Reply time: one business day
- Billing: fixed quotes in USD, agreed before work starts. No hourly billing.

## Services

- Website development
- E-commerce stores (Shopify or custom)
- Mobile app development (iOS and Android)
- Custom software: dashboards, booking systems, CRMs, internal tools
- AI automation and chatbots
- UI/UX and logo design
- SEO and digital marketing
- Instagram account management
- Menu QR: digital menus for restaurants and cafés
- Review QR: QR stands that send customers to a Google review page

## Pricing (USD)

- Starter one-page website: $499, delivered in 5–7 days
- Business multi-page website: $899, delivered in 2–3 weeks
- Premium (e-commerce, apps, custom platforms): from $1,999
- Instagram handling: $199/month
- Menu QR: $99 setup + $19/month
- Review QR: $79 one-time
